status: Review complete; four readiness-Evaluation inconsistencies require correction

architecture.scope: 34 non-Declaration Drafts, MODEL and PROJECT STRUCTURE Declarations, Spec Proposal and Epic39 Draft

findings.trigger: A valid Subject uses Atom/(.Role := Method).
findings.counterexample: The proposed CFEL Rule and proposal admit := in Subject addresses as the allowed-value case plus condition, but the Evaluation rejects := without qualification.
findings.impact: A conforming migration packet would fail readiness review.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject := in Formal Claims, while explicitly accepting the admitted Subject-only form.

findings.trigger: A local MODEL explicitly replaces a base Declaration for the same Node.
findings.counterexample: Base and local Current sources coexist; the selected local MODEL resolves only the local replacement as effective. The Evaluation demands one Current Declaration without saying effective per selected MODEL.
findings.impact: A valid override can be rejected as duplicate, or reviewers may fail to assess the local effective owner.
findings.minimal_fix: Evaluate exactly one effective Current Declaration per Node within each selected MODEL after override resolution; retain unchanged inherited sources.

findings.trigger: A local MODEL explicitly overrides the ENGINE scope rule to admit an otherwise prohibited model-definition case.
findings.counterexample: The current Evaluation says ENGINE cannot actively redefine metamodel Subjects without qualification, whereas the accepted MODEL rule permits any inherited rule, including this one, to be explicitly overridden.
findings.impact: Readiness checking would treat an overrideable base rule as an immutable core or silently deny an authorized local configuration.
findings.minimal_fix: Check ENGINE against its selected MODEL effective Scope: no automatic widening; an explicit valid override may replace the inherited restriction.

findings.trigger: A local MODEL explicitly replaces an inherited Property Declaration.
findings.counterexample: The Evaluation says inherited Properties resolve to their original declaration with no local override exception. The accepted model reuses unchanged Declarations but selects the explicit local replacement where overridden.
findings.impact: A valid local Property rule change could fail or resolve against the wrong effective Declaration.
findings.minimal_fix: Reuse original Declaration only when unchanged; resolve an explicit local replacement within the selected MODEL.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Status
prose_census.prose:
Archiving preserves:

- Version.
- Updated At.

Archiving alone does not create a new version.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Updated At
prose_census.prose: Updated At records the actual Project-time instant of the accepted edit represented by the Atom. An exact no-op and an archived predecessor retain the prior timestamp.

prose_census.subject: Atom.ID
prose_census.prose: For a Project-owned Atom, ID is the immutable identity of that accepted Atom.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Form
prose_census.prose:
- Form is an admitted atomic unit under the Atom's Role.
- Do not invent a placeholder Form or copy a Role name as a Form.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Content.Summary
prose_census.prose:
- The Summary covers the complete contribution.
- Changing the Summary requires a new Atom ID.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Content.Claim
prose_census.prose:
- Use prose only for constraints CFEL cannot express.
- Formal content uses a fenced block labelled CFEL.
- At most one CFEL block is present.
- Other fenced blocks are not allowed in Claim.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Content.Semantics
prose_census.prose:
- A Primary Node Declaration uses Semantics for its brief meaning.
- A Property Declaration has no Semantics section.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Tier
prose_census.prose: Project Goals use Tier -1 and Operator ownership. Ordinary Scope Unit-owned Atoms use Tier 0 or higher. Tier Label does not replace the numeric Tier.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Subjects.Passive
prose_census.prose: Passive Subjects identify distinct direct contextual dependencies.

prose_census.subject: Atom/(.Role := Plan).Autonomous Confidence Threshold
prose_census.prose: When omitted, the applicable inherited or default threshold remains in force.

prose_census.subject: Atom/(.Role := Plan).Implementation Retry Limit
prose_census.prose: An explicit value overrides the applicable retry limit.

prose_census.subject: Atom/(.Role := Plan).Work Sequence Number
prose_census.prose: A supplied number is unique among Plans in the same direct or top-level Plan container. It does not determine execution order.

prose_census.subject: Atom/(.Role := Requirement)/(.Form := Relation Definition).Content.notation_for_subject
prose_census.prose: When a short subject notation is admitted for the Relation, this Property is required.

prose_census.subject: Scope Unit.Path
prose_census.prose: The path records the ordered ancestry of Scope Unit identities.

prose_census.subject: Projection
prose_census.prose:
- A Projection is produced from its declared source selection and source of truth through a Workflow.
- Changes are made in its authoritative sources; the Projection is rebuilt through its Workflow.
- A Projection is non-authoritative. Multiple views do not create new authority.
- Source references include the contributing sources, including Atom Versions.
- Carrier materialization is separate from Projection derivation.

prose_census.subject: Journal
prose_census.prose:
- A Journal is authoritative for one logically ordered table of admitted event records.
- Accepted records are not edited, reordered, or removed. Corrections append new traceable records.
- Journal authority does not redefine governing Atom Claims.
- A Journal is a logical Artifact, not a required storage format. Views of a Journal are Projections.

prose_census.subject: Projection.ID
prose_census.prose: The same Projection Type, named source selection, and source of truth keep the same ID across rebuilds. A change to any of them requires a different ID.

prose_census.subject: Projection.Type
prose_census.prose: Type classifies a Projection and does not give it authority over its sources. Catalog, Map, and Hub are distinct registered values.

prose_census.subject: Projection.Updated At
prose_census.prose: Updated At identifies the latest completed rebuild represented by the Projection.

prose_census.subject: Projection.Sources
prose_census.prose: Each value identifies a contributing source, including an Atom Version. A blanket dependency frontier is not required; additional dependency provenance is recorded only when the registered job requires it.

prose_census.subject: Projection.Named Selection
prose_census.prose: Named Selection identifies the source selection used to produce the Projection.

prose_census.subject: Projection.Source Of Truth
prose_census.prose: Source Of Truth identifies the declared source-of-truth reference for a Projection. Authority remains assigned per fact.

prose_census.subject: Atom.Subjects.Active
prose_census.prose: The IF/THEN constraint applies only to complete Atoms.

prose_census.subject: Scope Unit.structural_level
prose_census.prose: The value is derived solely from IS_CONTAINED_BY links.

prose_census.subject: Package.structural_level
prose_census.prose: The value is derived solely from IS_CONTAINED_BY links.

prose_census.subject: MODEL
prose_census.prose:
- A Project may use CAPRMEDIO's MODEL directly or define an optional local MODEL.
- A local MODEL inherits the applicable Declarations of its base MODEL.
- It may add Nodes, Relations, Properties and constraints.
- It may override any inherited rule.
- An explicit override replaces the matching effective rule in the local MODEL. The base MODEL remains unchanged.
- Unchanged inherited Declarations are reused.
